history.administration_response: The Administration has increased targeted monitoring and outreach to entities in 2024 to help them to improve their performance. Results from several response mechanism pilots have helped to improve the first and second lines of defence and shown positive performance trends in some areas. New monitoring tests and analytical procedures are being developed in response to emerging risks and events. This is an area on which the Business Transformation and Accountability Division will continue to focus as part of its continuous improvement approach. As part of the 2025 project for the continuous improvement of the monitoring framework, the Administration plans to document its approach in a standard operating procedure on monitoring of delegation of authority, at which point the recommendation will be implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that, in 2024, the Administration enhanced monitoring and developed new mechanisms, and that, as part of its 2025 project for continuous improvement, it is working on documenting its approach in a standard operating procedure on monitoring, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.sg_progress: The Business Transformation and Accountability Division has continued to enhance targeted monitoring and outreach efforts to support entities in improving their performance. The implementation of response mechanism pilots has contributed to strengthened monitoring across the first and second lines of defence, as reflected in positive performance trends. The Division is now routinely developing new monitoring tests and analytical procedures in response to emerging risks and events. As such, while this recommendation remains valuable, its implementation has evolved into an ongoing practice and is increasingly embedded in standard operations. To close this recommendation formally, the Division will document this continuous improvement approach within a delegation of authority monitoring standard operating procedure, at which point the recommendation will be considered implemented. The standard operating procedure was postponed because of a lack of availability of key staff due to competing priorities and the impact of resource constraints.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration continue efforts to strengthen the accountability framework for delegation of authority by enhancing the analytical approach to identify systemic issues hampering the improvement of entities’ performance against targets, and make concrete recommendations to entities involved on how to improve their performance against the key performance indicators.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The delegation of authority monitoring framework was redesigned to implement the requirements of this recommendation. The Business Transformation and Accountability Division routinely develops new monitoring tests and analytical procedures in response to emerging risks and risk events as part of its standard approach to continuous improvement. For example, in 2025, the Division prioritized the monitoring of low-value acquisitions (see detailed information and evidence provided below in response to the recommendation contained in para. 346 of the Board’s 2024 audit report (A/80/5 (Vol. I)), use of funds commitments and delegation of authority to separated and affiliate personnel. The Administration has documented the monitoring tests and analytical procedures in a standard operating procedure, which is a live document subject to continuous improvement.
history.board_assessment: Given that the delegation of authority monitoring framework has been redesigned, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
